description: A dark corridor dominated by two giant spools spinning a massive, black-and-red fabric ink ribbon. The fabric is dripping with thick, dark, chemical ink that pools in the valleys below.

iron_wall.description: Thick iron plating that forms the chassis of the typewriter. Impassable.

ribbon_floor.description: A steel walkway running alongside the giant ribbon.

exit_south.description: A gap leading south back to the shock keys.

exit_north.description: A narrow metal hatch leading north to the roller platen.

ink_pit.effectMessage: SPLASH! You step into a puddle of corrosive typewriter ink! Your laces burn!
ink_pit.description: A deep puddle of bubbling, pungent black ink that has dripped from the ribbon.
